dedupe_keys.name: integrated multi sector energy transition pathways for senegal by 2050

description: Dan-Baibe Sébastien Ahmany and co-authors publish a dataset for multi-sector energy-transition pathways in Senegal by 2050. Its short description links a Senegal case-study branch of the GENeSYS-MOD training repository. The five file descriptors identify an hourly-data spreadsheet, three input workbooks labelled ID, BAU and NZ, and a ZIP results bundle. Those labels are preserved without expanding assumptions that the metadata does not define. These files form one national energy-system planning dataset. Zenodo offers free access under CC BY 4.0. The stated horizon is 2050, but the start year, represented sectors, regional subdivision, variables and hourly-data vintage remain unknown. The related GENeSYS-MOD record describes the model family. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; the linked code and all spreadsheet values remain uninspected.
